v4.6.109 — Day bot take-profit fix: positions no longer slip past their target unsold

🛟 Fixed a real protection bug: when you ran the same bot (Day, Long or Short) on BOTH Alpaca and IBKR, the two instances secretly shared one state file on the server. Each one's bookkeeping only knew about its OWN broker's positions, so it would wipe the other broker's tracked stop/take-profit brackets — leaving a position unprotected. That's why a price could sail past the take-profit zone without anything selling, and why win/loss counts drifted.

Now every bot keeps its own per-broker state, exactly where the app already looks for it. Each instance tracks and re-arms its own positions, so the take-profit/stop-loss safety net works again and the W/L tally is accurate.

Update via the in-app banner.
